# Hotel Vijay, Rajgir
> Hotel Vijay is a family hotel in Rajgir, Bihar, India (PIN 803116), beside Ram Krishna Math on Hot Spring Road, Bangali Para. It has 33 rooms (Non-AC, AC and Family rooms), free Wi-Fi, free parking, a lift, a restaurant and a 24/7 front desk. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98356 20220.
